metadata.domain: High-Nickel Cathode Materials / Secondary Battery Materials

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6→completion in 2 years) and T03 (TRL 6→completion in 2 years) are reasonable progressions from mid-maturity, while T08 (TRL 4→completion in 4 years) is somewhat aggressive but plausible for a process technology with sufficient investment.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 기술선도 (Technology Leadership), which calls for exploratory, lower-TRL, R&D-heavy portfolio with longer timelines; however, two of three selected technologies are already at TRL 6, which is near-commercial, making the portfolio more consistent with 시장이익최대 than genuine technology leadership.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies (high-nickel cathode doping, precursor process optimization, battery recycling) are squarely within the High-Nickel Cathode Materials / Secondary Battery Materials domain, demonstrating strong domain fit and relevant competitive positioning in the battery materials supply chain.
evidence.market_timing: T08 (배터리 재활용) completes 3.25 years after its boom window, representing a severe miss; T03 completes 1 year after boom; even T01 finishes 0.5 years late, and for 기술선도 strategy the target should be 1-2 years BEFORE the boom, making all three technologies poorly timed for preemptive leadership.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: T01 and T03 show reasonable alignment between patent activity in high-nickel cathode materials and market opportunity scores (both rated 4-5), but the selection of only 3 technologies with limited evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting makes this appear partially coincidental rather than systematically intentional.

strengths: All selected technologies are domain-coherent, fitting the High-Nickel Cathode Materials / Secondary Battery Materials space without off-domain drift
Dependency chain between T01 and T03 is logically sound and properly sequenced, ensuring foundational material work precedes process optimization
weaknesses: Portfolio is dominated by TRL 6 technologies, fundamentally contradicting the 기술선도 strategy which requires lower-TRL exploratory investments and R&D-heavy positioning
Systematic late-completion timing across all three technologies — particularly T08 missing its boom by 3.25 years — means the roadmap will arrive well after market opportunities peak
missing_technologies: Low-TRL (TRL 2-4) next-generation cathode chemistries (e.g., single-crystal high-Ni, Ni-rich NCMA beyond 90%) for genuine technology leadership
Solid-state electrolyte compatibility for high-nickel cathodes — a critical patent-dense frontier area aligned with 기술선도
AI/ML-driven materials discovery for novel dopant combinations — low TRL but high strategic value for leadership positioning
investment_issues: Allocating Strategic tier to T01 (TRL 6) is appropriate for market execution but inconsistent with 기술선도 — Strategic investment should anchor lower-TRL breakthrough technologies

T08 receives High tier investment despite executability score of 2.0 and a 3.25-year timing miss, suggesting capital is being deployed into a technology that will not return value within the strategic window
No investment in TRL 1-3 exploratory technologies despite 기술선도 mandate, leaving the portfolio without genuine long-horizon differentiation
timing_issues: T08 (배터리 재활용): completes 2030-Q1 vs boom 2026-Q4, a 3.25-year miss — the market will have matured before the technology is ready
T03 (전구체 합성): completes 1.0 year after boom; for 기술선도 it should complete 1-2 years BEFORE 2029-Q1, i.e., by 2027-Q1
T01 (고결정도 도핑 양극재): 0.5 years late; for 기술선도 preemption, it should have targeted completion by 2026-Q3 at the latest
